class.name: algo_nav2_plugins/GridPlanner
class.description:
Nav2 global planner adapter backed by the algo_core planner registry. The `algorithm` parameter selects which registered planner runs; this workspace ships exactly one, `astar`.
Register several named instances of this class in planner_plugins to keep several planners loaded simultaneously and select one per request through the ComputePathToPose planner_id field.
